test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Which among the following is not a tributary of Brahmaputra river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tons**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Tons River is a** major perennial Himalayan river that flows through the Garhwal division of Uttarakhand and touches Himachal Pradesh.**

 
 
• **​**It is the** largest tributary of the Yamuna River.**
 
• Having a **length of 148 km.**
 
• The **source** of this river is** Bandarpuch Mountain.**
 
• Tons River carries below Kalsi, near the town of Dehradun in Uttarakha
